description: Global Nutrient Yields publishes nitrogen and phosphorus loads and yields for catchments worldwide through Lincoln University’s Figshare repository. The database harmonises 640,950 measurements from 1,421 catchments over seven years centred around 2008, then models yields for 6,020 catchments. Shapefiles provide nutrient-yield estimates, while additions in 2025 include raster products and CSV loads for HydroBASINS levels 3 and 4. Free downloads carry CC-BY-NC-4.0. The resource can calibrate catchment water-quality simulations and compare nutrient pressures on drinking-water treatment or wastewater receiving waters. It complements data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins with nutrient attributes, not drainage geometry alone. The producer explicitly advises against use finer than HydroBASINS level 4, despite the finer raster representation. Modelled yields cannot replace monitoring measurements at individual locations. Original concentration and discharge sources have their own reuse policies, so the deposit’s noncommercial licence should not be replaced by the article’s broader language about processed data.
